query: Can I upgrade my operating system? What are the system requirements?
ground_truth: For Mac OS X, upgrade support depends on version/model; e.g., OS X 10.12 requires a Mid-2008+ supported Mac, 2GB memory, OS X 10.6.8 or later, and 64GB available space. [KB0005010] Windows 7 KB requirements list a 1 GHz processor, 1 GB RAM (32-bit) or 2 GB (64-bit), and 16/20 GB free space. [KB0000021]
response: Yes, all computers can upgrade to any operating system automatically.

query: Are Copyrighted Files Illegal to Have On My Computer?
